decisions.evidence: Overall, the direct halogenated alerts from the chloroalkene at 1 and alkyl chloride at 2 dominate the interpretation, and despite some exposure-limiting features such as neutral fraction absent at 0, heteroatom count 7, and TPSA 74.6, the molecule is best classified as mutagenic.
Since all six comparisons end up favoring the same direction overall, the combined evidence supports option (B): is mutagenic.
